name: factscribe
description: A local workbench for writing papers: open your manuscript projects, read the check report, the fact ledger and the knowledge base, and let the assistant propose edits you approve before anything reaches the file. Numbers and citations stay pinned to the ledger; the AI proposes, you decide.
author: UncleMoc · BGISMALL
exampleQueries: Check this paper's report and fact ledger for numbers that do not match
Propose a tighter rewrite of this introduction and show me the diff first
